'''Stickli root''' was a type of root that could be used to make [[Stew/Legends|stew]]. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] used to store the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]{{'s}} galley with stickli root.<ref name="Shadows of Mindor">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref>
